presenter_prompt: We're launching a fall pumpkin cold brew LTO for a national coffee chain. Generate 3 rapid storyboard concepts using our lowest-cost fast models in Microsoft Foundry, evaluate prompt adherence, and then render the best concept in high fidelity with native audio using our approved hero cup image.
prompt: Cinematic close-up of the Northwind Pumpkin Cold Brew cup from the approved hero image: cold brew pours over ice, pumpkin cream cascades down, condensation beads on the cup, slow dolly-in, golden-hour rim lighting. Native audio: ice clinking, liquid pour, soft cafe ambience. Keep the Northwind logo and label sharp and undistorted.
